info.title: Oh My Product API
info.summary: Public JSON API for Oh My Product, a social launch community for builders and early adopters.
info.description: Read the launch status, the public guides and the list of products Omi discovered, join the launch list, submit a product for private review, request a beta Test Drive, and register an anonymous agent identity. Oh My Product is in closed beta: the API exposes no review, post, profile or member data. The products are discoveries by Omi, the site's product scout: not user reviews, customers or maker participation, and their descriptions are unverified third-party claims. Every write accepts the X-OMP-Sandbox header (or ?sandbox=true) to validate without storing or sending anything, and the sandbox server https://ohmyproduct.com/api/sandbox/v1 mirrors every operation with that mode forced on. Versioned in the URL: v1 makes no breaking changes; anything removed is deprecated first, with Deprecation and Sunset headers at least 90 days ahead (policy: https://ohmyproduct.com/developers#versioning). Human documentation: https://ohmyproduct.com/developers. Agent registration steps: https://ohmyproduct.com/auth.md.

x-deprecation-policy.guarantee: No breaking changes within v1. Clients must ignore unknown response fields and headers.
x-deprecation-policy.breaking_changes: Removing or renaming an operation, path, parameter, field or error code; changing a type or meaning; adding a required request field; narrowing accepted values; changing the status of an existing outcome, the pagination envelope or the authentication scheme.
signals: Link rel="deprecation" and rel="sunset" response headers
deprecated: true and x-sunset on the operation in this document
x-deprecation-policy.new_versions: A breaking change ships as a new version path (/api/v2) next to v1, which keeps working for at least 90 days after the new version is available.

servers.description: Sandbox. The same operations, validation, limits and response shapes as production. Every write is answered with "sandbox": true and nothing is stored, no email is sent and no database budget is charged; reads return the same public data. Every response carries X-OMP-Sandbox: true.

get.description: Lists the products discovered by Omi, the Oh My Product scout: name, the product's own URL, a one-line description, category, tags and the date it was added. These are discoveries, not user reviews, customers or maker participation, and the descriptions are unverified third-party claims summarized by Omi; the provenance block says so and must travel with the data. Filter with category, search with q (lexical), and follow next_cursor until it is null. Reviews, posts, profiles and member data are not available.

parameters.description: Page size: the maximum number of products on this page (1 to 100, default 25).

post.description: Adds an email address to the Oh My Product launch list, with the same validation and limits as the form on /launch. Only submit an address whose owner asked you to. Joining twice answers already_joined. Send an Idempotency-Key header to retry safely: the same key and body replay the first answer.

post.description: Adds the token to the revocation list until it expires (RFC 7009). Revocation is held per server instance; tokens live one hour. Always answers 200 for a well-formed request.

revoked.description: True when a valid token was added to the revocation list.

request_id.description: Also sent as the X-Request-Id header.

Error.description: Error envelope used by every /api/v1 response with a 4xx or 5xx status.

OAuthError.description: OAuth-style error (RFC 6749 §5.2) used by /agent/identity and its revocation endpoint.

SandboxHeader.name: X-OMP-Sandbox
SandboxHeader.description: Set to true to validate the request and receive the real response shape with "sandbox": true. Nothing is stored or sent. On the sandbox server (https://ohmyproduct.com/api/sandbox/v1) every write is sandboxed whatever this header says.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional key that makes a retry safe (IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header). The same key with the same body replays the first successful answer with Idempotent-Replayed: true; with a different body it is 422 idempotency_key_reused. Kept for up to 24 hours per client, best-effort per server instance. 1 to 255 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : ~ + / = - (a UUID works), optionally quoted as an RFC 9651 string.

X-Request-Id.description: Request identifier; also in error bodies as request_id.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745: present only when this operation is deprecated, as @<unix seconds> of the deprecation date. Paired with Sunset and Link rel="deprecation"/rel="sunset". See https://ohmyproduct.com/developers#versioning.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594: present only when this operation is deprecated; the HTTP date after which it stops working (at least 90 days after Deprecation).

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key and body. Absent otherwise.

LinkNext.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page (rel="next"), present while next_cursor is not null.

X-OMP-Sandbox.description: true when the request ran in sandbox mode: on every response from the sandbox server, and on writes sent with the sandbox flag. Absent otherwise.

agentBearer.description: Anonymous agent access token from POST https://ohmyproduct.com/agent/identity (one hour). Scopes: docs:read, launch:write. See https://ohmyproduct.com/auth.md.
